- Fixes the app crashing a few seconds into a video when 7TV, BTTV or FFZ emotes can't be loaded (for example when a DNS lookup fails on a VPN). Playback now continues, just without those emotes.
- Fixes a crash when leaving the player while the app is closing.

Installs over v1.1.0 and later directly. If you're still on v1.0.0, uninstall it first; it was signed with a different key.
